items.t: Stability control may brake or cut power unexpectedly

items.note: A software update and fluid change sometimes fix it. If the transmission must be replaced, expect much more.

items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.note: Often covered by recall or extended engine warranty if the knock-sensor update was done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Steering wheel air bag may come loose
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.note: Often covered by extended engine warranty up to 15 years/150,000 miles if the knock-sensor update was done.

items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.
